title: Pay for the Parker date and royalties
summary: The date paid union scale, forty-four dollars for sidemen and eighty-eight for the leader, with small royalties still coming from Arista.

blocks.x: Did you make any money on that record date?
... Union scale... $44 for sidemen, $88 for the leader... I have recievd a few royalties through Arista label, they bought the company... As far back as that was I still get a few schecks, ha ha...
